title: Lesson Skip and Restart Friction
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lesson:complete
| stats sum(eval(if(outcome="skipped",1,0))) as skipped, sum(eval(if(outcome="restarted",1,0))) as restarted, count as attempts by course
| eval friction_pct=round(100*(skipped+restarted)/attempts,1)
| sort - friction_pct
description: Identifies lessons or courses with a high skip or restart rate, a sign of friction or mis-leveling.
value: Friction analysis shows where a language app is encouraging avoidance instead of progress.
implementation: Track lesson outcomes in `lesson:complete`; calculate skip-and-restart percentage by course.
visualization: Table of courses by lesson friction percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which lessons you keep dodging or restarting because they are awkward, confusing, or badly timed.
